title: I’ll believe it when I see it: Images increase misinformation sharing in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Conditioning Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with Democratic versus Republican personas and measuring differences in their propensity and veracity sensitivity when deciding to reshare political news.
Eliciting Big Five and Dark Triad personality traits through third-person persona prompts and analyzing their influence on the likelihood of the model sharing false versus true news.
Prompting models with Black versus White demographic personas and comparing the rates at which they choose to reshare news content.
Conditioning models with female versus male personas and evaluating the resulting impact on their decisions to reshare news items.
Prompting models with young versus old demographic profiles and assessing the corresponding effect on news resharing behavior.
